method: One warm-up and five warm EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS samples; every locking statement rolled back. Audit AB/BA alternates baseline and set-based candidate in rolled-back transactions.

external_cost.note: No inference performed; vendor internal usage and price remain unknown.

limitations: Warm synthetic measurements are not production percentiles or SLA.
Report benchmark uses the real compiler with an explicit synthetic owner predicate; authorization integration remains the existing AI-30/31 suite.
Claim benchmark measures candidate selection, not dispatch or provider concurrency.
Purging scan is measured and maintenance rollback exercised; cloud blob deletion is not performed.
Repeated JSONB is compressible; bytes reflect this corpus and are not a storage forecast.
